name: Sign-in Cards
description: Sign-in and sign-up cards with validated fields, a password reveal and social sign-in.

props.name: onSubmit
props.type: (values: { email: string; password: string; remember: boolean }) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Called with the values once every field is valid. A returned promise shows a spinner on the button and disables the form until it settles.

props.name: providers
props.description: Social sign-in buttons under the divider. One shows its full label, two share a row with their names, three or more show marks only. Pass [] for none.

props.name: onProvider
props.description: Called when a social button is pressed.

props.name: onSwitch
props.description: Called by the "Create one" link in the footer. The footer is hidden without it.

props.name: onForgotPassword
props.description: Called by the "Forgot password?" link.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading, set in the display face.

props.name: description
props.default: "Sign in to pick up where you left off."
props.description: Muted line under the heading.

props.name: logo
props.description: A mark shown above the heading.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Label of the main button.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts every other div attribute.
